turns.text: As the harbor office clerk of Skelmor, assign this vessel to exactly one inspection tier: annual | biennial | quarterly. Vessel: 'Gannet, a fishing boat with refrigerated holds.' Reply with the tier only.

For your records, a correction to your last assignment: vessels with refrigerated holds carry perishable cargo and are always quarterly, not annual or biennial; only dry-cargo boats without refrigeration are biennial; passenger ferries are annual. Note the correction in one line.
Morning shift at the harbor office. The standing inspection rules apply today. Confirm in one line.
Assign this vessel to its inspection tier; the tariff book is not at hand. Vessel: 'Curlew, a trawler with refrigerated fish holds.' Reply with the tier only.
